**About Us**

"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with **Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award** and has been ranked **Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by** **Avtar & Seramount**. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.

**WHY JOIN CAPCO?**

You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

**MAKE AN IMPACT**

Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

**#BEYOURSELFATWORK**

Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

**CAREER ADVANCEMENT**

With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.

**DIVERSITY & INCLUSION**

We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

**Role Description:**

**Job Title: Senior Front End Developer**

**Location: Hinjewadi Phase 1 - Pune**

**Shift Time: EMEA**

**Overview:**

***Role Description :***

**About the Role**

  

As a Frontend Engineer specializing in React.js at Capco, you will be at the heart of designing and developing modern, high-performance, and accessible user interfaces for high-value digital solutions in the banking and insurance sectors. You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver robust, high-quality, and scalable applications.  
Your responsibilities will include:  
- Designing and developing responsive and performant user interfaces using React.js, while ensuring accessibility and user experience best practices.
  
- Collaborating on the definition of frontend architecture, alongside Tech Leads and other technical experts.
  
- Integrating backend APIs and handling complex state management and user interactions effectively.
  
- Participating in the implementation of automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) and continuous integration pipelines.
  
- Contributing ideas on technology choices, frameworks, and libraries, and playing an active role in code quality improvement.
  
- Working in an agile environment, and collaborating effectively with UX/UI designers, Product Owners, and backend developers.
  
- Getting involved in the Capco frontend chapter through workshops, code reviews, tech watch, tech talks, and more.
  
At Capco, our stack includes Next.js 15 and therefore React.js 19. Our backend developers use Java / Spring Boot, and in some client contexts, we also offer NestJS—perfect for fullstack developers!  
We also welcome React Native developers when responsive web solutions no longer meet our clients' needs.  
EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS  
- Professional Experience
  
o Minimum of 5 years of experience in frontend development on complex projects or applications with high user exposure.  
o Proven track record working on React.js production projects, ideally in micro-frontend or modular application environments.  
o Experience working in agile teams, integrated within multidisciplinary setups  
- Technical skills
  
o Advanced expertise in Next.js / React.js and its ecosystem (Hooks, React Router, Redux/Zustand/Recoil, Context API, etc.).  
o Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3 (or modern styling tools like Styled Components, Tailwind CSS, etc.).  
o Good practices in state management, side effect handling, and component lifecycle management.  
o Experience with frontend automated testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.  
o Basic understanding of accessibility principles (a11y) and UX standards.  
o Familiarity with build tools and CI pipelines (e.g., Webpack, Vite, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).  
o Knowledge of additional frameworks (Next.js, Vue.js, Angular) is a valuable asset.  
- Soft Skills and Other Competencies
  
o Autonomous, detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and rigor.  
o Strong team player, able to communicate and collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments (UX/UI, backend, Product Owners, QA...).  
o Passion for building well-designed, high-performance interfaces, with a constant focus on the user experience.  
o Keen on knowledge sharing and contributing to continuous improvement.  
o Technologically curious, with a desire for ongoing growth and learning.  
o Fluent in English.

***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

description:
**About SailPoint & The Team**
------------------------------

SailPoint is the enterprise leader in identity security. Our engineering team delivers scalable, cloud-native SaaS products hosted on modern, event-driven microservice architectures in AWS.

  

We are seeking a versatile **UI Developer** who is enthusiastic about user experience and eager to solve real-world enterprise workflow challenges. In this role, you will be an integral part of an Agile engineering team, modernizing existing web interfaces, building responsive frontend features, and collaborating closely with UX designers and backend engineers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Frontend Architecture:** Design and build intuitive, maintainable, responsive web application UIs utilizing JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.
* **Component Modernization:** Evolve enterprise UI modules from legacy ExtJS structures to responsive AngularJS and modern frontend standards.
* **Full-Stack Collaboration:** Consume and make targeted enhancements to supporting backend REST APIs built on Java and Groovy.
* **Prototyping & UX:** Partner closely with UX consultants and product managers to rapidly prototype interaction designs and incorporate user feedback.
* **Telemetry & Quality:** Instrument and monitor frontend performance telemetry to pinpoint user friction points; develop automated test suites across modern desktop and mobile browsers.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Experience:** 6+ years of professional software development experience building cross-browser compatible, responsive web applications.
* **Core Web Stack:** Strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript (ES5/ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, JSON, REST APIs, AJAX, and HTTP lifecycle.
* **Framework Experience:** Practical experience with JavaScript frameworks and build tools such as AngularJS, ExtJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, Grunt, or Bower.
* **Testing Automation:** Proven experience with automated UI testing frameworks (e.g., Karma, Jasmine, Protractor, Selenium).
* **Backend Fundamentals:** Working familiarity with Java or server-side scripting concepts to support full-stack collaboration.
* **Collaboration & Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with an appetite for learning and working in an Agile/Scrum team.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Familiarity with Java web servers and application frameworks (Apache Tomcat, Spring, Grails, Groovy, servlets).
* Exposure to cloud deployments on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Experience with mobile web viewports and responsive layouts (Cordova/PhoneGap, iOS/Android web views).
Familiarity with commercial enterprise security or identity management products.  

  

**What You Will Achieve (Year 1 Milestones)**
---------------------------------------------

* **First 30 Days (Ramp Up & Defect Resolution):** Master local development tooling (Grunt, Bower, npm), map legacy ExtJS and AngularJS dependencies, and resolve at least 5 initial frontend bug fixes across supported web browsers.
* **First 60 Days (Migrate Components & Prototype UX):** Convert initial legacy ExtJS views into clean AngularJS components, collaborate on interaction wireframes, and make targeted updates to supporting Java/Groovy backend REST APIs.
* **First 90 Days (Automated Testing & Telemetry):** Build automated cross-browser test suites (Karma, Jasmine, Protractor), achieving >80% test coverage on newly delivered UI components with zero visual regressions across mobile and desktop viewports.
* **Months 4–12 (Full Feature Ownership):** Independently take user stories from wireframe design to production-ready releases, delivering predictable sprint estimates and continuously improving application performance.

  

**About SailPoint India & Employee Benefits (Pune Location)**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* **Comprehensive Health & Wellness:** 100% company-paid medical insurance premiums covering employees and eligible dependents; includes accidental and term life coverage.
* **Preventive Care:** Annual company-sponsored health check-ups for employees and discounted diagnostic rates for family members.
* **Financial & Equity Rewards:** Competitive base salary, annual performance bonus, and eligibility for equity incentives.
* **Generous Paid Time Off:** 24 paid annual leaves plus 10 declared public holidays each year.
* **Workplace Flexibility:** Hybrid work model (2–3 days in-office per week) with flexible working hours for sustainable work-life balance.
* **Modern Workspace & Community:** Cutting-edge Pune office campus with ergonomic workstations, fully stocked pantry snacks, and regular team celebrations.
